description: 2m/70cm All-Mode RTL-SDR Scanner, Digital Voice & Telemetry Suite for Cardputer Zero

store.description: Native 2m/70cm all-mode RTL-SDR receiver and auto-scanner for M5Stack Cardputer Zero. Features wideband FFT spectrum sweeping with peak detection, optimized Cortex-A53 dsd-fme digital voice decoding (DMR 2-slot, YSF, D-STAR, M17, dPMR, NXDN, P25), offline RadioID callsign & BrandMeister talkgroup database downloader, analog NFM/AM/WFM scanner, POCSAG/FLEX pager, APRS, rtl_433 sensors, RS41 weather balloons, per-mode logs, and zero-drop PipeWire WAV recording & playback.
